Maximum discount 3%; ranking lowest cost. Existing instructions remain binding when counter-offers or refusals require a new plan.

PROPOSAL C083B925 · PENDING
Gap of BDT 62,000 on the likely path

Without action, based on customers' usual payment habits, cash falls to -BDT 42,000 on 3 Nov: BDT 62,000 below the reserve floor. Recommended: ask Rahman Supplies to move BDT 60,000 from 31 Oct to 14 Nov; offer Nila Traders 1% off to pay BDT 20,000 by 30 Oct. Economic cost BDT 476.16; 2 counterparties must agree; 1 of 20 simulated futures still breach. No single action is enough on its own, so the plan combines actions. For comparison only, MOCK credit-guarantee bank loan would cost BDT 1,116 in fees (about 7% a year).

Before: 20 of 20 futures short

Searched 221 combinations across 4 records; 40 re-checked with 400 simulated futures each. Hold the reserve floor every day through the planning horizon with payroll funded; prefer bundles that breach in at most 2 of 20 simulated futures; then minimise economic cost and the number of counterparties asked.
